works.body:
Hello! Would you be willing to draw my FFXIV character, Zagylona Zagylbyrgwyn? She's a tall Viera bunny girl with a charming and playful personality. Her job is to discover and explore lost ruins. Her passion, outside of her work, is to discover new cafes to frequent along her adventures (coffee, tea, and cookies are the best!). She believes that a strong body and mind are necessary for a successful adventurer, so she trains rigorously and reads books in her free time. Key words: exploration, ruins, adventure, coffee, tea, cafes, cookies, water, ocean, wind, books, reading, lavender, rose, athletic, stretching, running, training, baths, hot springs, cheer , blue sky, sun, bright, confident, energetic, optimistic. You can decide the pose, expression, and background. Please draw whatever inspires you from her description. Thank you for considering my request!
